searchText: 254GB is a lot yeah what about the 14k scenario? If we go to 14K, then it’s about 110GB, is that still a lot? because there's still no opposition evident to that on the CL thread or elsewhere of which I'm aware (if so, they should make themselves more known I guess) and then in hegota we could go down even further with Kev's EIP, also https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8146 would solve this issue somewhat as we remove BALs from `ExecutionPayload` but iirc it's already declined 110GB is still quite a lot but managable
